messages.subject: Re: simple error with getSpeciesImages
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
if possible please always provide the code you ran. It makes it easier to spot the problem.

The error message says:
metadataSpeciesTag 'Snow leopard' not found in image metadata tag 'HierarchicalSubject'.

So apparently you assigned argument metadataSpeciesTag = "Snow leopard". I suspect that it should be something like metadataSpeciesTag = "Species" (depending on how you set up your digiKam tag tree).
metadataSpeciesTag is the name of the tag group that contains the species labels, not the species label itself.

See here  <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/vignettes/SpeciesIndividualIdentification.html#metadata-tag-structure>for an example.
Best,
Jürgen

The Date/Time Original is within the range, but not the Create Date. Just to test, I have changed the date range in the CTable to include both dates, but it has not worked as well.

Any idea?

Thanks in advance

messages.subject: Re: Error: record date outside camera operation date range
messages.subject_clean: Error: record date outside camera operation date range
messages.body_plain:
Dear Bernat,
yes, there is some conflict between the date/time of your records at 4 stations (01C1, 01C2, 01C4, 01C5) and the setup/retrieval dates at those stations.

The recordTable function extracts the DateTimeOriginal tag, not CreateDate. In that particular image you gave the date/time for, what date and time is shown in the image itself? I am sursprised that CreateDate is earlier than DateTimeOriginal, Normally it should be the other way around.

You can check the dates and times of your records and camera traps like this (assuming your station column is called "Station", and your setup and retrieval columns are called "setup" and  "retrieval"):

range(recordTable$DateTimeOriginal[recordTable$Station == "01C1"])       # the range of DateTimeOriginal at station 01C1

CTtable$setup[CTtable$Station == "01C1"]      # setup date at station 01C1
CTtable$retrieval[CTtable$Station == "01C1"]   # retreival date at station 01C1

Best,
Jürgen
